name: io.github.toolweather/toolweather
title: Toolweather
description: Toolweather suite: MCP server health (~2,000 servers), AI/dev API status (~40 providers), model deprecations, SpendGate spend scoring before an agent pays, and PayCheck merchant checks before an agent pays a host or wallet. One MCP endpoint. Zero signup: 50 free/day anonymous or 1,000/day with a free key; heavier use pay-per-call via x402 (no subscription). SpendGate and PayCheck tools use each product's own quota.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional free API key (1,000 calls/day). Without a key you still get 50 free calls/day anonymous. Get a key instantly: POST https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/keys or the get_api_key tool.

_meta.io.github.toolweather/when_to_use: Before adding/calling a third-party MCP server: check_mcp_server_health. Before calling an AI/dev API or after 5xx: check_api_status. Before hard-coding a model id: check_model_deprecation. Before an agent pays: score_spend (approve, ask_human, or block). get_quota is SpendGate's free-score cap. spendgate_get_api_key mints a SpendGate key; get_api_key mints a Toolweather key (renamed because the names collided). Before paying a merchant, host, or wallet: check_merchant (trusted, unknown, suspicious, or block). paycheck_get_quota is PayCheck's free-check cap (renamed because get_quota is SpendGate's). paycheck_get_api_key mints a PayCheck key. Anonymous bundle clients (anon:) stay at PayCheck's 100/day; a hex Toolweather client gets 1,000/day. Every result starts with a one-line summary, verdict, recommended_action, checked_at and freshness.
